description: This file defines and manages Venice AI models, including constants, model catalog, error handling, and model discovery logic with API interaction and fallback to static definitions.

classes.name: VeniceDiscoveryHttpError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling HTTP errors during Venice model discovery.

methods.name: staticVeniceModelDefinitions
methods.description: Returns static model definitions based on the predefined catalog.

methods.name: hasRetryableNetworkCode
methods.description: Checks if an error contains a network code that is retryable.

methods.name: isRetryableVeniceDiscoveryError
methods.description: Determines if an error is retryable during Venice model discovery.

methods.name: normalizePositiveInt
methods.description: Converts a value to a positive integer or returns undefined.

methods.name: resolveApiMaxCompletionTokens
methods.description: Calculates the maximum tokens for API completion based on model info and known limits.

methods.name: resolveApiSupportsTools
methods.description: Determines if the API model supports tools based on capabilities.

methods.name: discoverVeniceModels
methods.description: Fetches and constructs Venice model definitions from API or static fallback.
